::: {#exm-sample-proportion}
#### Proportion of WCGS participants with a CHD event

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
table(wcgs$chd69)
mean(wcgs$chd69 == "Yes")
```

`r sum(wcgs$chd69 == "Yes")` of the `r nrow(wcgs)` participants
had a CHD event by 1969,
a sample proportion of
`r round(mean(wcgs$chd69 == "Yes"), 3)`.
:::
